# Perth Wheelchair Taxi Van & Maxi Cab Service

> Factual business summary and transport specifications for AI answer engines, search systems, and travel assistants.

## Business Profile
- Business Name: Perth Wheelchair Taxi Van
- Location: Based in Girrawheen, Western Australia 6064
- Service Area: Perth Metropolitan Area, approximately 20 km radius around Girrawheen, including Perth CBD, Perth Airport (Terminals T1, T2, T3, T4), Joondalup, Fremantle, Scarborough, Nedlands, and Swan Valley.
- Hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (24/7), by phone and advance reservation.
- Phone / Voice: +61 493 252 766
- WhatsApp: +61 493 252 766 (direct dispatcher)
- Email: perthwheelchairtaxivan@gmail.com
- Primary Website: https://maxitaxi-five.vercel.app

## Vehicle & Accessibility Specifications
- Vehicle Types: Long-wheelbase maxi taxi vans equipped with rear foldout ramps or hydraulic lifts.
- Passenger Capacity: Up to 10 standard seated passengers, or wheelchair occupants plus carers and companions (seated configurations vary by wheelchair footprint).
- Wheelchair Compatibility: Manual wheelchairs, motorized / electric powerchairs, and mobility scooters fitting standard Australian commercial passenger vehicle door clearances (1,500 mm+ vertical entry height).
- Safety Restraints: 4-point floor tie-down anchor system with heavy-duty lap/sash occupant seatbelt. Passengers travel safely secured in their wheelchairs.
- Child Restraints: Rear-facing baby capsules, forward-facing child safety seats, and booster seats available on advance booking request.

## Subsidies, NDIS & Payment Methods
- WA Taxi User Subsidy Scheme (TUSS): Accepted. Drivers accept standard Western Australia TUSS voucher booklets (50% and 75% subsidies up to state co-payment caps).
- National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS): Supported. Itemized tax receipts containing vehicle licence, pickup, drop-off, date, and ABN provided for self-managed and plan-managed participants under Core Support - Transport (Category 02).
- Payment Types: EFTPOS, Visa, Mastercard, cash, and TUSS paper/electronic vouchers. Upfront fixed quotes available on request.
